title: Slow Cooker Creamy Garlic Parmesan Meatballs
creator: FastCrock
servings: Not specified on linked page (nutritional info listed per serving; ~20-24 meatballs)
ingredients: For the meatballs: 1.5 lbs ground beef (80/20) or beef/pork mix
For the sauce: 1 (14.5 oz) can chicken broth (low sodium preferred)
4 oz cream cheese, softened and cubed
2 tablespoons cornstarch + 2 tablespoons cold water (optional slurry)
For serving: 1 lb spaghetti or other pasta
Fresh parsley, extra Parmesan, and black pepper for garnish
instructions: In a large bowl, gently combine the ground meat, panko, egg, onion, 2 minced garlic cloves, 1/4 cup Parmesan, salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, optional red pepper flakes, and parsley. Do not overmix.
Optional: brown meatballs 2-3 minutes in 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium-high heat, then transfer to the slow cooker. Or place uncooked meatballs directly in the slow cooker.
Whisk together chicken broth, heavy cream, cream cheese, 4 minced garlic cloves, 1/2 cup Parmesan, dried parsley/oregano, 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, and 1/4 teaspoon salt until mostly smooth.
Pour sauce evenly over the meatballs.
Cover and cook on LOW 4-6 hours or HIGH 2-3 hours until meatballs are cooked through and tender.
Optional thicken: about 30 minutes before serving, stir in a cornstarch slurry (2 Tbsp cornstarch + 2 Tbsp cold water) and continue cooking until thickened.
Cook pasta until al dente; drain. Serve meatballs and sauce over pasta; garnish with parsley, Parmesan, and black pepper.
notes: From a FastCrock Facebook Reel. Caption describes dump-and-go meatballs simmered in heavy cream, minced garlic, and Parmesan (video shows frozen meatballs). Creator-pinned full recipe link used for quantities/steps: https://food.freshtonerhungar.com/2026/11/06/slow-cooker-creamy-garlic-parmesan-meatballs/ (homemade meatballs; FAQ says frozen pre-cooked meatballs work). Commenters noted milk/broth vs cream confusion between video and written recipe.
